name: aau-ce2-ai-study-hub
description: Static study webapp for AAU CE2 AI/ML/DNN/RL exam preparation

scripts.refresh-figures: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.resolve('../exam_prep/figures');const dst=path.resolve('dist/figures');if(!fs.existsSync(dst)){console.log('Run npm run build first');process.exit(1);}let n=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src)){if(/\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp)$/i.test(f)){fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dst,f));n++;}}console.log('Copied '+n+' figures.');"
